as_told.title: Schrödinger's 1944 What Is Life lectures on aperiodic crystals

plain: The physicist Erwin Schrödinger, in a book called What Is Life?, which Michels dates to 1944, wrote about "aperiodic crystals" in living cells. These are orderly structures whose pattern does not simply repeat. Michels says himself that Schrödinger saw them in DNA as important containers of information, and he brings it up twice as an early scientist's hint that life carries information in unusual ways.
